outcome: composite adverse perinatal outcome (stillbirth, neonatal death, meconium aspiration syndrome, 5-minute Apgar score <7, neonatal intensive care unit admittance, and sepsis)
composite adverse maternal outcome (maternal death, placental abruption, postpartum hemorrhage of >1000 mL)
cohort: Obstetrical low-risk women with a singleton pregnancy at term from the Netherlands Perinatal Registry from 1999 to 2010, excluding those with congenital anomalies, hypertensive disorders, or diabetes mellitus
finding: After adjusting for parity, onset of labor, and gestational age, advanced maternal age is associated with an increase in both composite adverse perinatal and maternal outcomes.
gest_age: Term pregnancies and beyond (late and postterm)
